en.content: The Vernier constant of Vernier callipers is 0.1 mm and it has zero error of (0.05) cm. While measuring diameter of a sphere, the main scale reading is 1.7 cm and coinciding vernier division is 5. The corrected diameter will be _________ 102 cm.
en.explanation:
Since zero error is negative, we will add 0.05 cm.

Corrected reading = 1.7 cm + 5 0.1 mm + 0.05 cm

= 180 102 cm
